title: Minimum Prime Bound in Square Intervals
summary: This paper presents a proof of Legendre’s Conjecture by analyzing the distribution of odd composite and their elimination through odd composite sequences. The odd integer sequence is expressed as 𝑂≥3 = 3 + 2𝑟𝑂, while odd composite numbers are represented as 𝑂𝑝 = 𝑝2 + 2𝑝𝑟𝑝, where 𝑝 is prime and 𝑟𝑝 ≥ 0. Each prime-square sequence introduces a systematic elimination of odd composite numbers, reducing the density of primes in the sequence.
